title: アルゴリズムデザイン
subtitle: Algorithm Design
keywords: Graph theory 2.Algorithm design techniques 3.Undecidability 4.Intractability 5.Approaches to hard problems
educationalGoal: In this class, students learn various algorithm design techniques to design efficient algorithms for many complex problems. Furthermore, students also learn knowledge on hard problems, and algorithmic approaches to such hard problems.
advice: In this class, students learn various algorithm design techniques, such as, greedy method, divide-and-conquer, and dynamic programming. Students also learn base of undecidability, i.e., there exists problems that can not be solved by computers. On the other hand, student learn base of intractability, i.e., it is believed that many problems can not be solved in polynomial time. In spite of such negative facts, students learn some tractable approaches for such hard problems.
requiredKnowledge: It is desirable for students to have taken "Formal language and automata". Prior knowledge of formal language is especially helpful although it is also taught in the course.

activityGoals.body: Be able to explain algorithms using greedy method.
Be able to explain algorithms using divide-and-conquer.
Be able to explain algorithms using local search.
Be able to explain algorithms using dynamic programming.
Be able to explain NP completeness.
Be able to explain approaches for hard problems
